topics.name: Video and interactive audio-visual generation
topics.summary: Interactive avatar and image-conditioned video systems combine multimodal synthesis with temporal checks, identity preservation, and iterative correction. Applications span real-time communication and creative production, with emphasis on perceptual quality, source fidelity, and scalable generation.

topics.name: Uncertainty-aware statistical and biosignal modeling
topics.summary: Posterior representations, pooled EEG classifiers, conformal selection, Gaussian processes, and adaptive EEG generation address noisy observations and heterogeneous signals. The studies emphasize calibration, cross-subject transfer, spatial or temporal structure, and reliable downstream prediction.

topics.name: Language-agent evaluation and long-horizon reliability
topics.summary: Benchmarks and deployed-agent studies test production workflows, enterprise extraction, tool allocation, web search, laboratory planning, and lifelong scientific assistance. Admission controls, verified tasks, learned judges, and trajectory analysis expose failures that short-answer accuracy misses.

topics.name: SAR and rotation-equivariant 3D perception
topics.summary: SAR diffusion models and point-cloud registration methods use structural priors, spherical harmonics, equivariant features, and scale-aware pretraining. Experiments target controllable radar synthesis, rotation-robust correspondence, and transferable representations for geometric sensing.

topics.name: Precision tactile manipulation
topics.summary: Tactile manipulation studies quantify hand-pose distortion in glove measurements and the demonstration burden created by tighter tolerances. Pose-aware correction and scaling-law analysis clarify how sensing quality, expert input, and data budgets constrain precision.

topics.name: Language-model prompting and inference-time alignment
topics.summary: Prompt-count experiments and decoding or steering interventions examine how scale, language, layer choice, adapters, and activation edits affect reasoning and social behavior. The methods improve tutoring, inclusive rewriting, and toxicity sensitivity while exposing calibration and generalization tradeoffs.

topics.name: Neurosymbolic reasoning and theorem proving
topics.summary: Formal rules and learned search interventions guide language models through Lean proofs and multi-step logic. Inductive logic patches, symbolic checks, and consistency-aware reasoning reduce local mistakes while preserving a verifiable formal fallback.

topics.name: Radar-based human motion reconstruction
topics.summary: Radar-to-pose reconstruction and compact recognition models factor temporal and multi-entity structure instead of relying only on network depth. Simulation priors, sensor-stream attention, and transfer evaluation improve generalization across motion and activity settings.

topics.name: Statistical guarantees for inference and asymptotic learning
topics.summary: Probability-based lower bounds, anytime-valid covariate checks, and least-squares estimation of asymptotic constants provide certifiable inference or convergence behavior. The common focus is rigorous performance under sequential monitoring, nonstandard limits, and slow numerical regimes.

topics.name: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning and constrained control
topics.summary: Finite-horizon policy-gradient analysis, online evaluation under nonlinear utility risk, and actuator-aware reach-avoid tubes connect reinforcement learning theory with feasible control synthesis. The methods address estimation error, risk objectives, and dynamically admissible trajectories.

topics.name: Clinical machine learning and medical prediction
topics.summary: Clinical studies span metamorphic testing, longitudinal spectral CT, bone-age assessment, rare-disease reasoning, and fracture prediction from imaging and records. They pair medically meaningful validation or interpretable dynamics with comparisons across cohorts, modalities, and model families.

topics.name: Extremal combinatorics and differential posets
topics.summary: Extremal set constructions, arithmetic-progression intersection bounds, and computational investigation sharpen finite cases and challenge conjectured rank inequalities. Structural proofs are combined with exhaustive or human-AI-assisted search over combinatorial families.

topics.name: Embodied vision-language robotics
topics.summary: Simulation pipelines, multimodal navigation, dialogue robots, UAV tracking, manipulation, and one-shot system identification support physical agents under changing conditions. Sensor fusion, feedback, adaptation, and reliability modeling recur across interaction and control tasks.

topics.name: Secure code generation and compiler optimization
topics.summary: Code-generation studies use adversarial tests, realistic security scenarios, and compiler or intermediate-representation diagnostics to assess generated programs and kernel optimizers. Their evaluations reveal defects that ordinary execution feedback can overlook and connect repair to engineering risk.

topics.name: Retrieval-augmented search and grounded decision support
topics.summary: Vector-tree retrieval, shared embedding-generation, graph-text memory, and domain-specific evidence collection support product, fraud, emergency, nutrition, and multi-hop question tasks. Iterative evidence selection and traceable provenance improve decisions when model knowledge is incomplete.

topics.name: Operator learning and diffusion dynamics
topics.summary: Probability-measure optimization, mean-field generative models, neural operators, differential-form diffusion, quantum dissipation, and source-apportionment models study dynamics in continuous spaces. Acceleration, discretized sampling, operator discovery, and inverse recovery provide computational methods with theoretical support.

topics.name: Reservoir computing for temporal prediction
topics.summary: Algorithmic and photonic reservoirs examine how recycled computation, network topology, quantization, sampling, and hardware settings affect temporal prediction. Experiments cover chaotic signals, energy-aware semiconductor implementations, and reservoir-based reuse for discrete optimization.

topics.name: Combinatorial optimization and path planning
topics.summary: Exact and approximate solvers address time-dependent routing, student-resource allocation, and grid pathfinding through search abstractions and domain constraints. The recurring aim is dependable optimization with lower search cost under timing, capacity, and resource limits.

topics.name: Spectral analysis of neural networks
topics.summary: Analyses of stochastic optimization and attention capacity connect minibatch fluctuations, curvature, and task-relevant rank. The results use Hessian structure and attention-specific measures to explain sharpness changes and the mixing capacity of Transformers.

topics.name: Speech synthesis and paralinguistic prediction
topics.summary: Speech systems address Singapore English synthesis for unseen speakers and social inference from vocal signals. Fine-tuning, prosodic modeling, acoustic features, and transcript-based language estimates improve pronunciation transfer and selected interpersonal predictions.

topics.name: Domain-specific image segmentation
topics.summary: Benchmark studies compare lightweight transfer-learned encoders for satellite land-cover mapping and expert-decoding strategies for fine-grained food imagery. Their findings emphasize resource efficiency, category imbalance, overlap handling, and realistic evaluation datasets.

topics.name: Efficient multimodal and generative-model inference
topics.summary: Visual token pruning, mixed-precision allocation, latent-attention analysis, cached video search, omnimodal compression, and frequency-aware video coding reduce computation. Across visual and generative workloads, redundancy estimates preserve task-relevant content while lowering memory, token, or generation cost.

topics.name: Networked computing infrastructure
topics.summary: Networked systems co-design communication paths and computation placement, spanning CUDA remoting, diffusion-inference overlap, and 6G architectures. The work focuses on latency, throughput, synchronization, and scalable coordination across heterogeneous links and accelerators.

topics.name: Online recommendation and retrieval serving
topics.summary: Streaming stock recommendation and hybrid retrieval for product advertising combine refreshed models with lexical and semantic indexes. Both systems prioritize serving cost, response latency, evolving signals, and practical ranking quality in online environments.

topics.name: Continual and self-improving visual models
topics.summary: Generative replay, noisy-student self-distillation, and implicit policy updates improve visual models without requiring a fully supervised external teacher for every update. The studies examine robustness to distribution change, perturbed inputs, and feedback-conditioned behavior.

topics.name: LLM-assisted 3D design interaction
topics.summary: Garment generation, CAD completion, virtual-reality geometry editing, and immersive scene authoring use language prompts alongside spatial previews or structured conditioning. Feedback and error diagnosis help distinguish intended designs from misleading, contradictory, or underspecified instructions.

topics.name: Identifiability in latent-variable and inverse models
topics.summary: Latent-state identification, symmetry breaking, and city-scale source apportionment study when hidden structure can be recovered from indirect observations. The analyses provide recovery conditions, minimax limits, and diagnostics for ambiguity in statistical and physical inverse problems.

topics.name: Safety validation for autonomous systems
topics.summary: Falsification search, world-model security analysis, and sensitivity testing for automated-driving classifiers actively probe rare or misleading behaviors. Scenario generation and controlled perturbations reveal safety weaknesses that routine execution or aggregate accuracy can hide.

topics.name: Multiview and graph information fusion
topics.summary: Graph-embedded multiview learning, density-based fusion, and embedded hyperspectral processing combine complementary sources under structural and deployment constraints. The methods address unreliable residual information, heterogeneous representations, and efficient inference on constrained hardware.

topics.name: Feature selection and model influence
topics.summary: Lazy-training importance measures, orthogonal feature selection, topology-aware automated engineering, and directional influence functions analyze which inputs or training examples drive predictions. These methods seek interpretable, stable, and computationally manageable alternatives to opaque feature pipelines.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning for biological and physical systems
topics.summary: Scientific ML studies build or audit representations for neuronal morphology, calcium dynamics, gene regulation, particle physics, molecular properties, and interatomic modeling. Foundation-style pretraining, cross-dataset transfer, structured ontologies, and reliability analysis connect measurements with biological or physical outcomes.

topics.name: Domain-constrained machine learning
topics.summary: Industrial fault detection, cyber-physical anomaly modeling, flood prediction, and sleep staging inject physical, hydrological, or physiological structure into learned predictors. These constraints improve output validity, interpretability, and label efficiency across sensor-driven applications.

topics.name: Federated learning with heterogeneous modalities
topics.summary: Federated methods transfer descriptive patterns or multimodal structure without centralizing raw records. Privacy, non-IID clients, missing modalities, topology, communication cost, and recovery of information absent from local training are central concerns.

topics.name: Context-adaptive model computation
topics.summary: Context-conditioned inference, auxiliary visual signals, residual adapters, and dependence-controlled expert routing specialize frozen or shared models per input. The studies examine composability, signal stability, routing laws, and selective computation under fixed deployment budgets.

topics.name: Morphology-aware tokenization
topics.summary: Tokenizer optimization aligns vocabulary construction with greedy decoding and the morphology of classical Indian languages. Integer-program objectives, native-script data, and held-out fertility measurements reduce segmentation overhead and improve contextual efficiency.

topics.name: Information systems and language resources
topics.summary: Language-centered information-systems scholarship and multilingual corpora examine how linguistic framing shapes AI-mediated communication and model development. Interview-based theory is paired with persona-rich Indic dialogue, instructional data, and low-resource named-entity benchmarks.

topics.name: Online fair division of indivisible goods
topics.summary: Online allocation studies characterize when irrevocable assignments can preserve fairness and efficiency under budgets, valuation growth, density assumptions, and prediction error. EF1, Pareto optimality, resource augmentation, and learning-augmented guarantees define the feasible frontier.

topics.name: AI governance and regulated decision systems
topics.summary: Studies of regulated deployment, semiconductor sustainability, rule evaluation, hidden model behavior, and AI engineering debt develop safeguards for auditable decisions. Symbolic checks, exception analysis, consensus inference, and readiness criteria target reliability beyond benchmark scores.

topics.name: Multimodal representation and explanation diagnostics
topics.summary: Vision-language evaluations examine logical distinctions, caption quality, negation recovery, biomedical feature interactions, and concept-specific interpretability failures. The methods combine structured attribution, frozen-feature probing, and reconstruction-based tests to expose what multimodal models encode or miss.

topics.name: Stable plug-and-play image reconstruction
topics.summary: Iterative reconstruction methods stabilize inverse problems through contractive anchoring, nonexpansive denoisers, and operator-level control rather than task-specific retraining. Convergence behavior and late-iteration stability are treated as primary design criteria.

topics.name: Generative imputation for structured data
topics.summary: Latent-coordinate generative models reconstruct missing image features and mixed categorical-numerical tables. Evaluation combines distributional fidelity, perceptual quality, and downstream utility to assess whether imputed values remain useful beyond surface plausibility.

topics.name: Cross-sensory and musical interface design
topics.summary: Creative computing tools let artists map sensing, actuation, material qualities, and neural audio behavior into musical interfaces. The work emphasizes workshop-oriented exploration, inclusive participation, and iterative co-design over a single fixed application.

topics.name: Audio simulation and source separation
topics.summary: Physics-guided acoustic simulation reduces path-search and late-tail costs, while a configurable training stack supports reproducible music demixing and post-processing. Both contributions target practical, modular audio pipelines with measurable quality and efficiency.

topics.name: Financial market modeling and forecasting
topics.summary: Market studies model emergent behavior, leverage-related volatility effects, and crypto direction using regime changes, technical signals, and social sentiment. Their shared concern is adapting forecasts and explanations as market conditions shift.

topics.name: Computational models of affect and social behavior
topics.summary: Models and experiments examine cooperation, epistemic emotion, mental imagery, and risk decisions in interactive or social settings. Network structure, ordered transitions, icon design, and generative social simulations reveal how affect and representation influence behavior.

topics.name: Efficient neural network deployment
topics.summary: Knowledge distillation, latency-driven vision design, and quantized-computation theory target deployment under limited memory, precision, or energy. The results compare transfer quality, measured device speed, and the ability of added depth to offset low-bit arithmetic.

topics.name: Regret-based policy optimization
topics.summary: Regret losses in attention models and outcome-reward policy gradients connect no-regret game dynamics with limitations on unbiased, length-insensitive updates. The analyses clarify when weighting choices improve learning and when competing guarantees cannot coexist.

topics.name: Theoretical analysis of language-model behavior
topics.summary: Formal results bound hallucination tolerance and characterize how sequence dynamics distinguish language models. Error thresholds, dynamical separation, and sequence length yield limits on generative power and discrimination capability.

topics.name: Vision model auditing and adversarial robustness
topics.summary: Visual-system audits use reference-free image-quality proxies, out-of-length text tests, physical patch attacks, and cue-isolation experiments in medical segmentation. These probes identify dependence on intensity, texture, shape, receptive field, and evaluation setup.

topics.name: 3D registration, reconstruction, and semantic mapping
topics.summary: Synthetic pretraining, semantic data association, and leakage-controlled validation reduce the cost of patient-specific registration and photogrammetric reconstruction. Related systems jointly estimate poses, landmarks, object meaning, and reconstruction reliability from geometric observations.

topics.name: Graphics rendering and visual computing
topics.summary: Rendering systems address ray-traced ambient effects and passive timing signals for resistant CAPTCHA design. The work combines low-level visual computation with hardware-observable behavior and efficiency or security considerations.

topics.name: Human-centered educational technologies
topics.summary: Interactive learning systems study adaptive peer assistance in collaborative programming and accessible exploration of complex charts. Skill-sensitive hints and tactile or spoken representations support more productive help and stronger spatial understanding for blind and low-vision learners.

topics.name: Graph learning for structured systems
topics.summary: A circuit parasitic benchmark and a graph-compression study evaluate how structural heterogeneity, sparsification, coarsening, and signal propagation affect graph learning. The contributions emphasize reproducible datasets, propagation-aware metrics, and tradeoffs between fidelity, diversity, and oversmoothing.
